units.source_text: 啊，祖父的生命已不长久，恐怕延续不到我写完这些稿纸了。

en.t: Ah, Grandfather does not have long to live; I am afraid his life will not last until I finish writing these pages.

units.source_text: （我是准备了一百张稿纸来记这些日记的。）

en.t: (I had prepared one hundred sheets of manuscript paper to keep these diaries.)

units.source_text: 这几天美代不在，祖父眼看着衰弱下去。

en.t: Miyo has been away these past few days, and Grandfather has visibly grown weaker.

units.source_text: 他现在已经打上了死亡的戳记……

en.t: By now, the mark of death has already been stamped upon him...
